# contentful_webhook_signing_secret (Resource)

Manages the Contentful Webhook Signing Secret for a space. Creating this resource replaces any existing secret. Destroying it deletes the current secret, including one rotated outside Terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "contentful_webhook_signing_secret" "this" {
  space_id = var.contentful_space_id
  value    = var.webhook_signing_secret
}
```

A replacement in the same space with `create_before_destroy` can delete the newly written secret. See [ownership and recovery](../guides/secrets-and-state#webhook-signing-secrets) before replacing the resource or retrying a failed write.

## Write-only signing secret

With Terraform 1.11.1 or later, use `value_wo` and an ephemeral variable to keep the
complete secret out of this resource's plan and state. Use this example as an
alternative to the ordinary `value` example above:

```terraform
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.11.1"
}

variable "signing_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

resource "contentful_webhook_signing_secret" "this" {
  space_id = var.contentful_space_id

  value_wo = var.signing_secret
}
```

Changing from `value` to `value_wo` with exactly the same secret removes the
ordinary value from new state without a remote write. Historical state snapshots can still
contain the original value. See [write-only signing secrets](../guides/secrets-and-state#write-only-signing-secrets)
for input handling, rotation, and saved-plan behavior.

## Schema

### Required

- `space_id` (String) ID of the space for which the signing secret is created. Changing this value replaces the resource.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Symmetric key shared between Contentful and webhook receivers in the space. Must be exactly 64 characters matching `^[0-9a-zA-Z+/=_-]+$`. Exactly one of `value` and `value_wo` is required. Stored in Terraform state. Refresh cannot detect external rotation. Import leaves `value` null; applying the configured value can rotate the secret. Timeout-only updates preserve the secret and stored value. See [importing signing secrets](../guides/secrets-and-state#importing-signing-secrets).
- `value_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only signing secret, with the same format as `value`. Configure exactly one of `value` and `value_wo`. Requires Terraform 1.11.1 or later and accepts ephemeral values. The complete value is excluded from this resource's plan and state. See [write-only signing secrets](../guides/secrets-and-state#write-only-signing-secrets) for rotation and saved-plan behavior.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Contentful creation timestamp in RFC 3339 format, or null when omitted. It can change when the signing secret is replaced.
- `id` (String) Terraform resource identifier, equal to `space_id`.
- `updated_at` (String) Contentful update timestamp in RFC 3339 format, or null when omitted.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

~> Import leaves `value` null. Applying the configured value can replace the remote secret, including during a configuration-driven import. See [importing signing secrets](../guides/secrets-and-state#importing-signing-secrets).

Choose one of the following methods. Match the resource address and Contentful IDs to your configuration, then review the plan before applying.

### Import by identity

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) with `identity`:

```terraform
import {
  identity = {
    space_id = var.contentful_space_id
  }
  to = contentful_webhook_signing_secret.this
}
```

### Import by ID

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) with `id`:

```terraform
import {
  id = var.contentful_space_id
  to = contentful_webhook_signing_secret.this
}
```

### Import with the CLI

Use the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import). Set the shell variables to your Contentful IDs before running it:

```shell
terraform import contentful_webhook_signing_secret.this "${CONTENTFUL_SPACE_ID}"
```
